Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.qjournal.protocolPB

Interface QJournalProtocolPB

All Superinterfaces:
QJournalProtocolProtos.QJournalProtocolService.BlockingInterface
All Known Implementing Classes:
QJournalProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB
@Private public interface QJournalProtocolPB extends QJournalProtocolProtos.QJournalProtocolService.BlockingInterface
Protocol used to journal edits to a JournalNode participating in the quorum journal. Note: This extends the protocolbuffer service based interface to add annotations required for security.
